patterns.note: Centered content blocks with generous vertical and horizontal padding, creating an airy and spacious feel around key information.
A vibrant, playful accent palette (pink, orange, purple, blue) used for CTAs, links, and character illustrations, contrasting with a clean white and light grey base.
Large, bold sans-serif headings for section titles, often in a dark grey, paired with a lighter weight, highly legible sans-serif for body text.
Scroll-triggered reveals for content sections, where elements fade in and subtly slide up as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic browsing experience.
Extensive use of custom, whimsical character illustrations (CryptoKitties) as primary visual elements in the hero, collection displays, and educational sections.

technique_notes: Sections are revealed with a staggered fade-in and slight upward translation as they enter the viewport, likely orchestrated using a scroll-triggered animation library, leveraging the detected Lottie animations for specific interactive elements.
The main navigation bar transitions to a sticky state at the top of the viewport after the initial scroll, maintaining access to key links.
Playful, custom Lottie animations are integrated throughout the site for interactive elements and subtle background motion, enhancing the whimsical brand identity.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with a clean, legible body text and smaller uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on cards and buttons, creating a friendly and approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, especially in the hero and between major sections, with balanced spacing within card grids.

standout: The site's distinctive use of whimsical, character-driven illustrations (the CryptoKitties themselves) combined with a clean, modern layout and vibrant accent colors creates a unique blend of professionalism and playfulness. The integration of these custom illustrations throughout the site, especially in the hero and collection displays, is a core differentiator.
